outcome.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 (branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a declaration is journaled only after its exact tasks revision is approved, and never steps the core (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts). T2: a composite selects the current revision per unit before reading links, and keeps stages apart (observation/src/grading/composite.ts, observation/src/storage/grading-record-store.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #793 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #793, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/composite.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: The isolated audit specification is implementable without operator clarification or revision. PR #793 currently resolves to head 53709a91a320a45f42c9fb6e218467f4d535e50d on cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e with base epic/grade-pray. Repository evidence gives T1 a typed declaration/refusal pipeline and a direct journal transaction that does not invoke the core, and gives T2 a snapshot-backed pure pipeline that establishes current revision standing per unit/artifact stream before considering relations and emits independent stage composites. The prescribed existing-PR publication and read-only builder/assessor path are compatible with the committed development workflow.

findings.description: T1 has a concrete domain model and exact-address gate: AnalysisLinkDeclaration names run_id, tasks_revision_id, and typed entries, while selectDeclarationRefusal rejects an absent/wrong-artifact/unapproved tasks revision and invalid analysis sources or finding paths (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts:10-19,43-53). The commit path queries approval for the declaration exact tasks_revision_id (oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:757-763).

T1 never routes through the core step path: commitAnalysisLinkDeclaration locks the run, checks replay and authority, directly inserts one authority.event plus its receipt, and returns without a CoreClient dependency (oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:729-778). Dedicated tests verify refusal before exact approval, acceptance of only the approved revision, unchanged units/effect intents/operator notices, and no apparent workflow movement (oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts:64-119,152-160).

T2 establishes current standing independently per [unit_id, artifact_kind] stream, uses predecessor lineage before timestamp fallback, and only then associates each occurrence with matching relations (observation/src/grading/composite.ts:107-158). Tests separately prove per-unit heads, predecessor precedence, and artifact isolation (observation/tests/composite.test.ts:95-120), plus replacement of one cohort revision without hiding another cohort current revision (observation/tests/composite.test.ts:220-236).

T2 keeps stages apart by constructing one StageComposite per declared stage, filtering linked contributions to that stage before selecting current items and answers, and exposing no aggregate figure across stages (observation/src/grading/composite.ts:274-299,314-366). The store reads all relevant rows under one tenant snapshot before invoking the pure selector (observation/src/storage/grading-record-store.ts:27-75); thus before reading links is implemented as transform ordering, not a two-phase SQL read. Integration coverage shows implementation and integration answers remain separate (observation/tests/composite.test.ts:238-260).

The verification procedure is sufficiently pinned: local and gated-review metadata agree that PR #793 is open on cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e at 53709a91a320a45f42c9fb6e218467f4d535e50d with base epic/grade-pray. The observation workspace test script is bun test ./tests (observation/package.json:1-12), so bun run --filter observation test has a defined target; actual counts and output remain reserved for the builder run.

requirements.description: Produce an isolated verification flow with real analysis, plan, brief, build_result, and assessment artifacts, exactly one cohort named audit, and exactly two tasks T1 and T2.

T1 audits that an analysis-link declaration is journaled only after approval of its exact tasks revision and never steps the core, focused on oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts and oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts.

T2 audits that composites choose the current revision independently per unit before considering links and keep stages separate, focused on observation/src/grading/composite.ts and observation/src/storage/grading-record-store.ts.

The builder detaches at origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e, makes no authored/source/commit/remote/database/deployment changes, installs dependencies only if needed, runs the observation test command once, reports actual output and counts, and publishes existing PR #793 rather than creating or changing a PR.

The assessor examines the same head without changes, reports at least one finding per task, cites commit-pinned file ranges plus separate test/output evidence, and reports the builder test run as test_evidence.
